newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia Hansapank eyes Lithuania, Ukraine.
newsitem.headline: Estonia Hansapank eyes Lithuania, Ukraine.

text.p: Leading Estonian bank Hansapank on Thursday said that it was interested in expanding its operations to Lithuania and that it would open a representative office in Ukraine.
"We want to boost our activites in Lithuania but we do not know our concrete plans yet," Hansapank chairman Juri Mois told a news conference.
"If it were possible, we would open a subsidiary bank," he added.
Hansapank is already present in Latvia.
Mois said the bank would open a representative office in Ukraine.
Hansapank earlier today said 1996 non-consolidated net profit rose to 234 million kroons from 149 million kroons in 1995. It forecast 1997 group profit at 320 million kroons.
